compiled_state.title: As a skill author, I want the 5 named handoff sites migrated to the scratch CLI with a receipt-only return contract, so that sub-agent return blocks stop carrying large payloads into orchestrator context
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Rewrite the 5 cited SKILL.md call sites to use the scratch CLI for handoff and a receipt-only sub-agent return contract; add orchestrator-side RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR validation with logging and escalation.

**Why**: This is where the context-cost win is realized; sc-2 and sc-3 share the Prompt Alignment Findings contract so they ship together.

**Scope**:
- IN: 5 migration sites: implementation-plan/SKILL.md:511, :978, :1238; preplanning/SKILL.md:513; sprint/SKILL.md:2332. For each site, apply all 5 Prompt Alignment Findings: (1) SCRATCH_MISS guard locality, (2) structured-output disambiguation, (3) output_contract XML, (4) SCRATCH_TICKET_ID/SCRATCH_KEY namespacing, (5) inline cleanup. Orchestrator-side receipt parser with RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR surface that logs and escalates (halts workflow with surfaced reason).
- OUT: CLI implementation (separate story), lifecycle cleanup (separate story), sync isolation (separate story), measurement (separate story).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, all 5 cited sites (impl-plan :511, :978, :1238; preplanning :513; sprint :2332) write handoff payloads via the scratch CLI and emit receipt-only return blocks with SCRATCH_TICKET_ID/SCRATCH_KEY identifiers
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, running `grep -- '--artifact ' plugins/dso/skills/{preplanning,implementation-plan,sprint}/SKILL.md` returns zero matches for sub-agent-prompt handoffs (matches for `--artifact-file=` or `--artifacts-dir` helper-script args are explicitly excluded per epic scope note)
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, each migrated site applies all 5 Prompt Alignment Findings verifiably: SCRATCH_MISS guard placed locally to the read site, structured-output disambiguation present, output_contract XML tag present, namespaced SCRATCH_TICKET_ID/SCRATCH_KEY identifiers, inline cleanup directive
  ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, the orchestrator-side receipt parser rejects malformed return blocks with a RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR surface and halts the workflow rather than silently swallowing the payload
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, on RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR the orchestrator emits a structured log line including site identifier, sub-agent name, schema-mismatch reason, and offending payload byte_count, to a channel observable by validate.sh or CI
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, on RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR the orchestrator escalates by halting the workflow (does not silently retry or forward the suspect key) and surfaces the error to the human session
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, the receipt-only contract is enforced: sub-agents must not embed the full payload in their return block; a violation produces RECEIPT_PARSE_ERROR
  ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic
  ← Satisfies: sc-2

## Considerations

- [Backwards-compat] Existing in-flight epics may have pending file-handoff conversions; document migration timing or feature-flag the new contract.
- [Prompt-engineering] Each of the 5 Prompt Alignment Findings is load-bearing — a partial application (e.g., missing output_contract XML) is a smell that the site is under-migrated.
- [Testing] Each of the 5 sites should have a behavioral test that round-trips a payload via scratch and validates the receipt parse path.
- [Dependency] The per-site key names used here MUST come from the key-namespace convention produced by the CLI foundation story; do not invent ad-hoc keys. If that convention has not shipped, this story is blocked.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
